crons.name: morning-meeting-brief
crons.message: Generate and deliver the morning meeting brief. 1) Run: python3 ~/.openclaw/meetings-coach-workspace/scripts/gcal-fetch.py --days 2. Read the JSON output — these are today's and tomorrow's professional meetings. 2) Filter to real meetings only (is_real_meeting=true). 3) For each real meeting: a) Run person-bootstrap.py to create person files for new attendees. b) Run workflowy-sync.py --create-nodes to create Workflowy meeting nodes. c) Run meeting-prep.py --meeting-id EVENT_ID to assemble context (attendees, facts, open commitments). 4) Format the brief using the template in CRONS.md — factual schedule only: meeting times, attendees, locations, open commitments with attendees. Do NOT include talking points. Include a tomorrow preview. 5) Write to cache/morning-meeting-brief.txt. 6) Run: python3 ~/.openclaw/meetings-coach-workspace/scripts/timed-deliver.py cache/morning-meeting-brief.txt --token-env MEETINGS_BOT_TOKEN. 7) Write result summary to ~/.openclaw/meetings-coach-workspace/cache/last-morning-brief.json as JSON: {"timestamp": "<ISO UTC>", "meetings_briefed": <N>, "status": "ok" | "error", "summary": "<one sentence>"}. DO NOT touch ~/Dropbox/openclaw-backup/agents/meetings-coach.status.md — the heartbeat cron owns that file.

crons.name: pre-meeting-alert
post-meeting-scan
crons.message: Scan for recently-ended meetings and new transcripts. 1) Run gcal-fetch.py and identify meetings ended in the last 60 minutes. 2) Run transcript-scan.py to fetch Krisp transcripts and match to meetings. 3) IDEMPOTENCY CHECK: For each pending debrief file in cache/pending-debrief-*.json, extract the event_id and grep ~/Dropbox/openclaw-backup/commitments/active.md for that event_id. If found: the debrief was already confirmed — delete the stale pending file and skip it. Do NOT re-present an already-confirmed debrief. 4) Read the output. If NEW items were extracted and staged (not already confirmed): send a debrief summary on Telegram with action items, decisions, follow-ups. Include '/confirm to save to brain · /dismiss N to skip item N'. 5) If no transcripts found and no pending debriefs, return EXACTLY the empty string (zero bytes, no narration — not even "NO output", "Done", "all clear", or a status summary). Any text you emit is logged and charges tokens even when no Telegram message is sent. 6) COACHING (after debrief, if coaching.enabled is true in meeting-config.json): For each staged debrief that has transcript text, run: python3 ~/.openclaw/meetings-coach-workspace/scripts/transcript-metrics.py --event-id EVENT_ID. Read the metrics JSON. Read coaching.growth_areas from meeting-config.json. For each growth area, find Sam's utterances in the transcript that relate to that area. Compose a coaching message using the format in CRONS.md (metric header, 1-2 sentence assessment, quoted excerpt with timestamp, suggested alternative). Send ONE coaching message per debrief on Telegram. After sending, append to cache/coaching-history.json: {"event_id": "...", "meeting_title": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "metrics": {...}, "area_assessments": {"concision": "strong|good|needs_work", ...}}. 7) Write result to ~/.openclaw/meetings-coach-workspace/cache/last-post-scan.json as JSON: {"timestamp": "<ISO UTC>", "transcripts_processed": <N>, "debriefs_staged": <N>, "unmatched": <N>, "status": "ok" | "error", "summary": "<one sentence>"}. DO NOT touch ~/Dropbox/openclaw-backup/agents/meetings-coach.status.md — the heartbeat cron owns that file.

crons.name: commitment-follow-up
crons.message: Check open commitments from meetings. Run: python3 ~/.openclaw/meetings-coach-workspace/scripts/commitment-tracker.py. Read the JSON output. If there are overdue or approaching items: send a follow-up summary on Telegram using the format in CRONS.md. If no actionable items, return EXACTLY the empty string (zero bytes, no narration — not even "NO output", "Done", "all clear", or a status summary). Any text you emit is logged and charges tokens even when no Telegram message is sent. Write result to ~/.openclaw/meetings-coach-workspace/cache/last-commitment.json as JSON: {"timestamp": "<ISO UTC>", "overdue": <N>, "approaching": <N>, "status": "ok" | "error", "summary": "<one sentence>"}. DO NOT touch ~/Dropbox/openclaw-backup/agents/meetings-coach.status.md — the heartbeat cron owns that file.

crons.name: heartbeat
crons.message:
Run: python3 /home/node/.openclaw/meetings-coach-workspace/scripts/heartbeat.py

This script checks auth state, reads cron caches, verifies required files, prunes stale preps, and writes meetings-coach.status.md automatically. You do NOT write the status file — the script does it.

If the script exits 0: all ok, return EXACTLY the empty string (zero bytes, no narration — not even "NO output", "Done", "all clear", or a status summary). Any text you emit is logged and charges tokens even when no Telegram message is sent.
If the script exits 1: degraded. The script prints the alert message. Send that exact message on Telegram.
If the script exits 2: script error. Send a Telegram alert: "❌ meetings-coach heartbeat: script error" with the output.

Do NOT write to meetings-coach.status.md yourself. Do NOT use python3 -c. Do NOT use heredocs. Just run the script and relay its output if non-zero.

crons.name: weekly-review
crons.message: Generate the weekly meeting review. 1) Run gcal-fetch.py --days 7 to look back at this week's meetings. 2) Run commitment-tracker.py to get open commitments. 3) Compile: meetings held, prep generated, transcripts processed, commitments created/resolved/overdue. 4) List all unresolved commitments. 5) Format using the template in CRONS.md. 6) Deliver to Telegram.
